tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open / launch an installed app by name. Use for 'open X', 'launch X', 'start X'.

app.description: App name or mapped keyword, e.g. calculator, settings

tools.name: play_media
tools.description: Play a song, artist, album, video or station, optionally in a mapped app. Use for 'play X', 'put on X', 'play X on Y'.

query.description: What to play, e.g. Bohemian Rhapsody

app.description: Mapped app keyword, e.g. tune. Omit to use the default player.

tools.name: pause_playback
tools.description: Pause the current playback. Use for 'pause', 'pause the music'.

tools.name: resume_playback
tools.description: Resume paused playback. Use for 'resume', 'continue playing'.

tools.name: next_track
tools.description: Skip to the next track. Use for 'next', 'next song', 'skip'.

tools.name: previous_track
tools.description: Go back to the previous track. Use for 'previous', 'go back'.

tools.name: set_volume
tools.description: Set playback volume 0-100. Use for 'volume to 50', 'louder'.
